It’s time to steal all the Easter Eggs from the megacorps — the hunt is on now through April 30th! Show us you’re up to the mission.

[previewyoutube=UF_Hmx4x5yY;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/622770/Hacktag/

[h3]🐇 An Exclusive Story Mission[/h3]
Who hasn’t dreamed of sabotaging a multinational on behalf of the Easter Bunny? Get ready — the Easter rabbits won’t wait for you to complete the mission!


[h3]🎁 Unlock Easter Egg Special Items[/h3]
Farmer Outfit, Rabbit Mask, Farmer Hat… or even an Easter Island Head? Over a dozen spring-themed items are available to customize your character — and during the Easter Eggs event, your chances of unlocking them are even higher!

As part of their spring cleaning, the megacorps decided to redecorate their offices too!

We carried out a server migration and improvements earlier today in response to the connection issues you’ve reported.
Thank you for your understanding![/i]

notes.title: Hacktag's Major update is here!
notes.notes:
Hey Hackers,

We have some exciting news to share with you today! 

The patch you've been waiting for is finally here!  As you all know, this major update has been in the works for quite some time, and we are happy to say that it contains a lot of changes that will make your experience even better. 

Firstly, we want to thank you for your patience and support. We truly appreciate your feedback and suggestions, which have helped us make Hacktag the game it is today. 

We hope you'll enjoy it and we look forward to hearing your thoughts!


[h2]This update focuses on:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 💯 Fixed statistics
[*] 🏆 Fixed Achievements
[*] 🌐 Enhanced stability and network connectivity 
[*] 🐛 Fixed bugs 
[*] 😼 And more...
[/list]
You can find [b]the full patchnote below this news![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/622770/Hacktag/

[h2]Contact us[/h2]
We are eager to hear your thoughts about it [url=https://discord.com/invite/pieceofcake]on Discord[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/622770/discussions/]the Steam Forums[/url]. 

[url=https://twitter.com/HacktagTheGame style=button]Twitter[/url] [url=https://www.facebook.com/HacktagTheGame style=button]Facebook[/url] [url=https://discord.com/invite/pieceofcake style=button]Discord[/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/622770/discussions/ style=button]Steam Forums[/url]


[h1]The detailed patchnote v1.2[/h1]

[h3]Achievement:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed “Are we still friend”
[*] Fixed “Trained Monkey”
[*] Fixed “I am Hackerman”
[*] Fixed “Fantastic Fur”
[*] Fixed “Piece of Cake”
[*] Fixed “Red Pill”
[*] Fixed “Great Escape”
[/list]

[h3]Localization:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a Korean localization error in the Player Icon name
[*] Fixed a localization tag issue for graphic options
[*] Fixed bad fonts for Japanese, Korean and Chinese localization
[*] Fixed issue where mission title wasn’t the right one when player changing localization in-game
[/list]

[h3]General improvement:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed split-screen art bugs.
[*] Improved navigation in the customization menu with mouse and keyboard
[*] UI improvements 
[/list]

[h3]Bugs fixed:[/h3]

[h3]Network:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes matchmaking needs to be cancelled once before working
[*] Fixed an issues where players can be stuck in an infinite loading for several reason
[*] Fixed an issue where when back to lobby from one player doesn’t work for the second player
[*] Fixed an issue where players could sometimes be stuck in the lobby.
[*] Fixed an issue where players never found any game with online server queue.
[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes the host could press the ready button for the client player.
[*] Fixed an issue where information from the server wasn't refreshed, causing the player to be stuck in an infinite connection loop.
[*] Fixed a crash occurring when the host player clicks "ready" very quickly after finding a game in matchmaking mode
[*] Fixed an issue where players sometimes couldn't launch a new game online after disconnection
[/list]

[h3]In game:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed AI bugs with guards
[*] Issue where the final score was inconsistent between players
[*] Fixed an issue where the hacker and stealth characters were sometimes the same in solo mode
[*] Fixed an issue where players experienced game freezing when quitting a game
[*] Fixed issue where sometimes firewall stay red for the agent after opened it
[*] Fixed bug where the radar trap doesn’t call for antivirus
[*] Fixed an issue where hackers and agents didn't see the same animation.
[*] Fixed SFX issue: Incorrect music played when guards answered the phone
[*] Fixed issue where agent didn’t see the red ping after hacking IDS server
[*] Fixed an issue in the Boss Takedown mission where the pieces of code didn’t correspond to those on the boss's computer
[*] Fixed an issue where pressing "Continue" before the end of the ending screen animation finished didn’t trigger rewards
[*] Fixed an issue where skills weren’t unlocking
[*] In the mainframe mission, sometimes players encounter different symbol sequences that block them from completing the mission
[/list]

[h3]Tutorial:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed infinite loading when players try to rerun the tutorial for the second time
[*] Fixed issue where videos in tutorial wasn’t in a good order
[*] Fixed icon jittering in the tutorial
[/list]

[h3]Lobby:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed inconsistent icon for gamepad validation
[*] Fixed a bug where players could not create/delete characters
[*] Fixed an issue where avatar icons would turn blank
[*] Fixed issue where selected character isn’t highlighted
[*] Fixed an issue where the "ask for quit" pop-up appeared in the mission selection screen when pressing Escape to go back
[*] Fixed a bug where players could not create/delete characters
[*] Fixed an issue where players who leave the lobby received a pop-up message telling them that the other player has left
[/list]

[h3]Other:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where video options weren’t displayed correctly.
[*] Resolved gamepad issues (gamepad type reset when language changed)
[*] Fixed a bug with controller navigation in the friend list
[*] Context UI don’t change from world to personnel leaderboard
[*] Fixed an issue where players experienced game freezing when quitting a game
[*] Fixed a statistics issue where the number of missions played wasn’t correct
[/list]

[h3]Known bug:[/h3]
[list]
[*] blurry font issue for Korean localization
[/list]

notes.title: After 2 spooky weeks, Hackoween Special is now over 👻

After those spooky few weeks, Hackoween Special is now over. Pumpkins, graves and candles have been put back in the closet ... until next year!

notes.title: TGS: Leaderboard contest starts... NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28581748/3c922df789a80246990dcb7f883fd68745d7b3c1.jpg[/img]

Hello hackers, 

Do you think you're the best agent/hacker team of this community? It's time to prove it!  For Tokyo Game Show, we are running a leaderboard contest that will reward the best of you with Hacktag prizes. Hit the best possible mission score and climb to the first step of the podium 🏆

Whether you play the demo or the full version of Hacktag, your score will be taken into account. Using the demo will not have any negative impact on the final score, so don't hesitate to participate!


We will reward the 3 highest team scores. Each teammate of the winning teams will receive: 

🥇 1st place: 1 Hacktag bundle (including the game & the OST)
🥈 2nd place: 1 Hacktag game copie
🥉 3rd place: 1 OST 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28581748/413b3b15e0447cf6e880d988b09c28cbc1059202.png[/img]

If there's a tie in the top 3, we will simply reward more players than expected. A team cannot have two scores registered in the top 3, in this specific case only the highest score will be taken into account.

DISCLAIMER: As part of this competition, the current leaderboard will be reset.



The scores will close on October 3 at 2pm CEST. Any change of the leaderboard after this date will not be taken into account. Results will be announced shortly after on [url=https://twitter.com/HacktagTheGame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/HacktagTheGame]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://discord.com/invite/pieceofcake]Discord[/url]. Do not hesitate to contact us once these are revealed.


To read the full rules, [url=https://bit.ly/3ky0T3a]click here.[/url]


Good luck everyone ! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28581748/2c48edf7310319104c2e0fd648615db3cbde0aa8.png[/img]

notes.title: A new season begins: leave your mark on the leaderboard
notes.notes:
Hello hackers, 

A new season begins on Hacktag! Starting today, complete missions, achieve the highest score and reach the top of the leaderboard.



To start this new season, we have reset the leaderboard. But don't worry, we've kept all of the previous scores aside so we don't lose any of your best games.

This will last three months and will end with the reset of the scores displayed for the following season. The scores of previous seasons will be displayed very soon in a dedicated section 🏆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28581748/d286ecbacae88cd64871ed8cf986a2d32672b4ca.png[/img]

As you might guess, this first season will start now and end up at the end of the year. So, it is time to show us your hacker and agent skills by making the highest score possible! 



▶️ And from tomorrow, on the occasion of the Tokyo Game Show, a leaderboard contest will be organized to celebrate the start of this season as it should. More infos are coming on Steam and social media very soon, so stay tuned. But know that some gifts will be offered to the winners 🎁


I hope you enjoy this news as much as it does us and that you will give all you have to reach the first place 😉



Good missions everyone! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28581748/2c48edf7310319104c2e0fd648615db3cbde0aa8.png[/img]

Here is a news to give you some information about the patch that has been deployed this week (not without difficulties 😅) and what's coming in the next few weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28581748/49cd76b52a9161f3e8877bf004d0413a34025f44.png[/img]

[h2]Patch v1.1.10f2[/h2]
Indeed, Tuesday we've deployed the patch v1.1.10f2 to solved, among other things, some issues with the infinite "Connecting" in online mode. Unfortunately, following the uploading of this patch some players have had difficulty connecting to the server, caused by security modules that were a little too restrictive. So, we decided to roll back to the previous version while fixing this bug.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28581748/c376e73ea772d8db97fb3e5eff82047c172815a1.gif[/img]

Today, we can finally announce that this problem has been fixed and the new patch v1.1.10f3 is online! Thank you all for your understanding and your feedbacks.

You can find the complete patchnote [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/622770/view/2995431231332823850]here.
[/url]

[h2]What's next? [/h2]
We are very happy to announce that these patches are the start of a series of improvements that will arrive over the next few weeks in order to optimize connectivity, stability, statistics...

We will published them regularly to make all these improvements gradually and avoid too many changes at once. We can't wait to share all of this with you! 😉


[h2]Contact us[/h2]
If you have any questions or encounter problems during your games,feel free to contact us on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pieceofcake]Discord[/url] server, social medias ([url=https://twitter.com/HacktagTheGame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/HacktagTheGame]Facebook[/url]) or the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/622770/discussions/]Steam forums[/url].

notes.title: Hacktag v1.1.10f3 patch notes - better connections to MatchMaker
notes.notes:
[h1]2021-04-02 - Changelist v1.1.10f3:[/h1]

[u][b]Changes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] MOD:  improved MatchMaker handling of lags and high pings from players at connection
[*] MOD:  tweaked some parameters of security modules on MatchMaker server
[/list]

[u][b]Bug fix:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] FIX: pending connection to MatchMaker is no more skipped while authenticating for players with some latency to the server
[/list]

[h1]2021-04-02 - Changelist v1.1.10f2:[/h1]

[u][b]Changes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] MOD:  improved MatchMaker protocol to give better information for direct connections and relay servers
[*] MOD:  online games have now more chances to use direct connections between the players than the relay servers
[*] MOD:  improved online protocol to detect available network connections between 2 players
[*] MOD:  updated RakNet library (PC & Mac) for future platforms usages
[*] MOD:  improved logging of network connectivity tests
[/list]

[u][b]Bug fix:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] FIX: modified ingame "noise" and "digital" players imprints system to avoid case of running footsteps, coffee machine noises, failed hacks noises not detected by guards
[*] FIX: online games are now more stable
[*] FIX: fixed "connecting" text in korean on "press start" screen that sometimes resulted in crashes at start for korean players
[*] FIX: fixed one issue of infinite connecting while trying to join a game with another player online
[*] FIX: fixed case of being stuck at "loading" screen when exiting a game level
[*] FIX: fixed case of being stuck at "loading" screen when launching an online game
[*] FIX: fixed an network serialization error
[*] FIX: removed a potential memory leak
[/list]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/622770/discussions/5/1333474229078018921/?ctp=4#c3076495389992686325]See all patchnotes here.[/url]

notes.notes:
Hey hackers, 

Hope you are well! Hackoween is still available until November 2nd but not sure that Lexyk, C.L.A.W Media and Genethics hold till then.

We've taken a look at your games stats since the event started, and to say the least, you haven't gotten bored. Here is our report! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28581748/fe8f83d43ffd1f6926d3af71e543d8257cfe22ef.png[/img]

[h2]Happy Hackoween ![/h2]
Halloween is one of the most appreciated celebration of the year, and once again we have seen your enthusiasm for this event. 

Since Hackoween launch, there was more than 2550 games played ! Whoa, the guards have better watch out 😉 You are around 90, daily, coming to hack Lexyk, Genethics and C.L.A.W Media corporations, with an average of 20 simultaneously players.


[h2]New languages[/h2] 
We were also very happy to released the Japanese, Portuguese and Chinese localizations over the past two months, allowing new hackers from around the world to join our amazing community.

[olist]
[*] France: 16.82%
[*] Brazil: 15.04%
[*] Japan: 14.31%
[*] United States: 14%
[*] China: 6.65%
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28581748/f9a8220469a4e67fee790b69ea0a511cbcba767c.png[/img]

[*] And Continent with the Dr.Hackula jacket

notes.title: FIXED! Connexion issues : infinite connecting
notes.notes:
UPDATE 26 Apr: Good news hackers!

The infinite connection issue some player has experienced is now fully fixed for everyone.

You can now fully enjoy the Easter Egg event. so to your hacking minivans hackers!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IaYUaaE.gif[/img]

------------------------
Original post: 24 Apr

Hello hackers,

Few players have recently reported us infinite connecting issues when trying to play online with another player.

This is due to a recent problem with our relay servers which our smart and devoted dev team is currently working on fixing.

In the meantime, for thus encountering this issue and until the fix is live anytime soon, you can try a temporary solution by setting up  the ports forward of your modem/router to your computer for UDP and TCP protocols on port range 27015 to 27020

It will allow the game to make a direct connection with your friend when creating a game instead of using the relay servers.

[b]How to proceed :[/b]
[list]
[*] In your modem or internet router settings
there is a section called generally PAT/NAT or port forwarding.
[*]You must add a new rule for UDP protocol on port range 27015 to 27020 pointing to the local IP address of your computer.
[*]The internet traffic going to the ports of your modem will be forwarded to your computer and make you able to host a game directly, avoiding the game to select a relay server for you.
[/list]

You can find the details [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/622770/discussions/5/1675812484336576944/]here on the Steam forum [/url]if you need more support and we are of course also available via email: support [at] pieceofcake-studios.com or [url=http://www.hacktag-thegame.com/discord] Hacktag's official Discord server[/url]. 


Thank you for your patience, see you soon!

notes.title: The Hackoween update strikes back!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/djIdbx3.gif[/img]

Hello hackers and...happy Hackoween... part 2!

Last year’s Hackoween special was Hacktag’s first ever seasonal event while the game was still on Early Access.

Man, it seems like yesterday… But what goes around, comes around and we definitely feel like sneaking into offices during a thunderstorm, wearing a pumpkin hat is still relevant, we are excited to announce that Hackoween is officially back for a season 2 starting… Today! Hooray!


[h1][b]Hackoween strikes back this year with more content![/b][/h1]
Now that we are mastering this whole special event thing, we have sharpened our skills and this year’s Hackoween will be bringing way more content. You can watch the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8NgWaONUYYk]new trailer[/url] and check this out:

[h1][b]A Halloween special story mission.[/b][/h1]

Remember Vlad Van Pire? The bat actor from those black and white vampire movies we all used to love? C'mon I'm sure you do ;)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/94300dcbda7a3da969497e2dda5b82d844c2c7ee.png[/img]
Aaah the good, old days! Well, he’s back and needs your hacking skills to save his glorious final performance from the evil suits working at Clawmount Pictures.
So go help him for the love of ART.

[h1][b]2 New character outfits and skin tones.[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/8838a3ee984de0cf0f6f8279b50f67a4f3132099.gif[/img]
You can now unlock the "Dr.Hackula" and "Dark Web" all new outfits. Yeah, we brainstormed pretty hardcore to find the names.

Also, the foxes were the last guys introduced into the Hacktag universe and therefore they did not have their Halloween special skin tones. This is now taken care of and jealous, they can no longer be. 

[h1][b]Over 16 customisations items[/b][/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hKRtcc9.gif[/img]
Did you know? During the Hackoween period, the loot rate on every Halloween item is significantly increased, so don't miss the opportunity!

[h1][b]Levels are decorated + hackers UI [/b][/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/oU7VUgy.gif[/img]
Oh a new hacking interface color! Which color would you enjoy seeing for the next seasonal events? Tell us here, on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/622770]Steam forums [/url]or on [url=http://www.hacktag-thegame.com/discord]Hacktag's official Discord[/url] server!


The event will last two weeks starting now and is right on time for the Halloween Autumn Steam sales which means Hacktag is now 50% off!

Last but not least this update  v1.1.2f2 obviously includes few minors bug fixes you gently reported us on Discord and Steam forums.

Have fun hackers!

notes.title: The "Easter Eggs" update is right down the rabbit hole!
notes.notes:
Hello hackers, 

It's been a while! But I'm sure you'll find it was worth the wait: today we are releasing an all new seasonal event which also includes tons of new features! So hackers, be ready to go down the rabbit hole with Hacktag's first spring event called "Easter Eggs" and here is [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UF_Hmx4x5yY] the special trailer[/url].

As you may have guessed by the name of the update, it was supposed to be released "slightly" earlier...ːsteamhappyː But since we were close to make it with a lot of new features and fixes we thought a few days of delay would totally worthed it, and here it is!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/88f1425448d8a300d043fcf383b9333a6c50a427.png[/img]


Now let's see what those eggs are hiding!

[h1]Easter Eggs event special content.[/h1]

[b]New bodies and accessories for your characters[/b]
For the previous event, we came up with special "skin tones", but the costumes of the characters didn't change. This time, we rolled up our sleeves to bring you two new outfits such as those.... well... overalls and rolled up sleeves costume. ːsteamhappyː
[img]https://i.imgur.com/n1Mh83U.gif[/img]

[b]Easter special mission[/b]
 We had so much fun creating the Christmas special mission (the idea of a Walrus Santa who's a hacker genius is still making me laugh even now), so since Easter is one week later in Hacktag's world, here comes a new special mission event with a new and rather uncommon customer with an even more uncommon request...

[b]Every levels are blooming with Spring decorations[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Lgh8ijB.gif[/img]
As you have probably noticed by now, the levels in Hacktag are loaded with funny easter eggs and other references. So for this event we decided to put actual easter eggs into the building. Geddit? Yeah, I know, it is mindblowingly meta.


[h1]The New permanent content:[/h1]

[b]Behold, the new social menu![/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WJA1Pux.gif[/img]
Directly from the main menu you have now access to the all new "Social" menu. It not only contains a page where you can manage your friend list and invite them to a game, but also some of the new menus detailed below.

[b]Oh! Statistics! [/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/b752693022533e84614379aa20acabe016480662.jpg[/img]
The social menu also gives you access to statistics about your games & characters, which we have no doubt you'll enjoy checking once in a while. Please keep in mind that the data collection started a few months after early access release, so the Veteran hackers won't necessarly be able to track all of their incredible achievements.

[b]Player icons are here![/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/3295d8451e23822f91d470797b0a8862b314cf99.gif[/img]
We know you have been dreaming of it, it has now become a reality! From the social menu you can now select a player icon among the one you've unlocked. As you can see there are about 130 icons for now. And yes, I know, this board is screaming: "Gotta unlock 'em all!"

[b]You can now use your coins![/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/5260b36bfa14bb792fb45e6e4df228a62e090b6f.gif[/img]
Make it rain! Remember the coins you looted in the safes after winning a mission? Oh I know you do. Well you can use those to unlock items without waiting for winning it in a safe anymore.

[b]New shinyLeaderboard[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sAT8CvX.gif[/img]
And here another reason to have the fanciest hackers in the game, the new leaderboard shows the pretty faces of the teams who made their way to the top 5!

[b]Improved tutorial[/b]
In the previous tutorial, we made the choice to keep "secret" some gameplay features in order to allow the players to figure it out on their own. But! Only fools never change their minds and the new tutorial now explains many gameplay subtleties to help the newcomers.


[h1]2018-04-09 Changelist -  v1.1.0f5[/h1]
[list]

[b]Easter Eggs special content[/b]
[*] The Easter special mission.
[*] 2 new bodies (male and female) for the characters.
[*] 4 accessories.
[*] Every 24 levels are decorated.

[b]New content[/b]
[*] Improved tutorial with more gameplay features explained.
[*] New "Social" menu.
[*] New leaderboard display, you now see the avatars of the TOP5 players.
[*] New Friends menu to add and invite friends.
[*] You can now spend your coins to unlock items.
[*] You can choose your player icons.
[*] Many game statistics are now recorded and featured in the Statistics menu.

[b]Bugs fixes & improvement[/b]
[*] Pause menu is now showing a short tutorial of the objectives depending on the mission played.
[*] English version of the tutorial has been entirely reworked with the help of the community (thank you Rachel!).
[*]Droprate of items in lootboxes has been reevaluated. 
[*] Fix: Character progression is now always correctly saved after quiting the game.
[*] Fix: Antivirus won't get stuck in "caught state" anymore after tagging a node while an antivirus is chasing him.
[*] Fix: 5 buggued achievements are now fixed.
[*] Fix: Suppression of an exploit in some jails thatallowed the agent to escape without doing the minigame.


By the way, we will showcase Hacktag at [b] EGX Rezzed the 13-15th of April [/b]. If you are in London or planning to attend, we definitely have to meet! If so, drop us a line [url=http://www.hacktag-thegame.com/discord] on Discord[/url]!

Peace out Hackers!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/a3f847dd8b14c5a2b70329994b0a6f642fa2496e.png[/img]

 We had so much fun creating the Christmas special mission (the idea of a Walrus Santa who's a hacker genius is still making me laugh even now), so since Easter is one week later in Hacktag's world, here comes a new special mission event with a new and rather uncommon customer with an even more uncommon request...

[b]Every levels are blooming with Spring decorations[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Lgh8ijB.gif[/img]
As you have probably noticed by now, the levels in Hacktag are loaded with funny easter eggs and other references. So for this event we decided to put actual easter eggs into the building. Geddit? Yeah, I know, it is mindblowingly meta.


[h1]The New permanent content:[/h1]

[b]Behold, the new social menu![/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WJA1Pux.gif[/img]
Directly from the main menu you have now access to the all new "Social" menu. It not only contains a page where you can manage your friend list and invite them to a game, but also some of the new menus detailed below.

[b]Oh! Statistics! [/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/b752693022533e84614379aa20acabe016480662.jpg[/img]
The social menu also gives you access to statistics about your games & characters, which we have no doubt you'll enjoy checking once in a while. Please keep in mind that the data collection started a few months after early access release, so the Veteran hackers won't necessarly be able to track all of their incredible achievements.

[b]Player icons are here![/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/3295d8451e23822f91d470797b0a8862b314cf99.gif[/img]
We know you have been dreaming of it, it has now become a reality! From the social menu you can now select a player icon among the one you've unlocked. As you can see there are about 130 icons for now. And yes, I know, this board is screaming: "Gotta unlock 'em all!"

[b]You can now use your coins![/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/5260b36bfa14bb792fb45e6e4df228a62e090b6f.gif[/img]
Make it rain! Remember the coins you looted in the safes after winning a mission? Oh I know you do. Well you can use those to unlock items without waiting for winning it in a safe anymore.

[b]New shinyLeaderboard[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sAT8CvX.gif[/img]
And here another reason to have the fanciest hackers in the game, the new leaderboard shows the pretty faces of the teams who made their way to the top 5!

[b]Improved tutorial[/b]
In the previous tutorial, we made the choice to keep "secret" some gameplay features in order to allow the players to figure it out on their own. But! Only fools never change their minds and the new tutorial now explains many gameplay subtleties to help the newcomers.


[h1]2018-04-09 Changelist -  v1.1.0f5[/h1]
[list]

[b]Easter Eggs special content[/b]
[*] The Easter special mission.
[*] 2 new bodies (male and female) for the characters.
[*] 4 accessories.
[*] Every 24 levels are decorated.

[b]New content[/b]
[*] Improved tutorial with more gameplay features explained.
[*] New "Social" menu.
[*] New leaderboard display, you now see the avatars of the TOP5 players.
[*] New Friends menu to add and invite friends.
[*] You can now spend your coins to unlock items.
[*] You can choose your player icons.
[*] Many game statistics are now recorded and featured in the Statistics menu.

[b]Bugs fixes & improvement[/b]
[*] Pause menu is now showing a short tutorial of the objectives depending on the mission played.
[*] English version of the tutorial has been entirely reworked with the help of the community (thank you Rachel!).
[*]Droprate of items in lootboxes has been reevaluated. 
[*] Fix: Character progression is now always correctly saved after quiting the game.
[*] Fix: Antivirus won't get stuck in "caught state" anymore after tagging a node while an antivirus is chasing him.
[*] Fix: 5 buggued achievements are now fixed.
[*] Fix: Suppression of an exploit in some jails thatallowed the agent to escape without doing the minigame.


By the way, we will showcase Hacktag at [b] EGX Rezzed the 13-15th of April [/b]. If you are in London or planning to attend, we definitely have to meet! If so, drop us a line [url=http://www.hacktag-thegame.com/discord] on Discord[/url]!

Peace out Hackers!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/a3f847dd8b14c5a2b70329994b0a6f642fa2496e.png[/img]

notes.title: Update #40: version 1.0.2f4
notes.notes:
Hello hackers!

Today will be another "small update before the big one" type of update. It mostly involves some level design & localization fixes (see the patch note below).
As mentioned last week, the dev team has been very busy on delivering the first major post-release update which will bring cool content and address some highly requested features before the end of March. 

On a totally unrelated note, press reviews for the game keep coming, which recently led to having Hacktag evaluated on the good old fellow Metacritic. So if you are so inclined, you may plug in your nicest keyboard and support Hacktag by writing a cool user review there and therefore gaining many karma points. http://www.metacritic.com/game/pc/hacktag/critic-reviews

[h1]Making of Hacktag fun fact:[/h1]
As you may or may not already know, when we first started creating Hacktag universe 3 years ago, we decided to treat the corporations as special characters, with their own agenda & personality. We drew inspiration from actual and well-known compagnies and had a lot of fun translating their imagery and iconography into our colorful and funny world of anthropomorphic animals. But in the case of Genethics artistic direction, not only did we look at big pharma buildings for inspiration, but also took a recon trip all the way across the street... to study our very own office facade, Le Cargo in Paris. Check it out!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/3303e9a5c2b4c39e40d528c7b54f8100958cf6f5.jpg[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/HAyHess.gif[/img]
(Don't freak out, we don't own the whole building, we're just renting a 60m² open space there.;))

[h1]Patch note version v1.0.2f4[/h1]
[list]
[*] Pressing "E" key when adding a new friend in the friend list no longer ends the process of adding a friend.
[*] Level fixes on map #001070CF:  stealth-trigger zone around furnitures have been fixed.
[*]  Level fixes on map #0076ADF1: better collisions ders around furnitures and pillars.
[*]  Level fixes on map #0020FF1A:  furnitures that obstructed visibility have been removed.
[*]  Various localizations fixes in menus and mission briefings

[/list]
Have a nice week-end hackers!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/39d454697000547fa568b67bdb9ea01597eb9842.png[/img]

notes.title: Update #39: version 1.0.2f3
notes.notes:
Hello hackers!

We're in March! It means that Hacktag is marching towards its second month post-release! (yeah, we are good with dates at Piece of Cake studios). Since Feb 14th we published 5 updates and we keep tracking the bugs down. But as you can see in today's update, it contains mainly gameplay fixes which mean that we're close to having solved all the major online issues that could prevent two players to connect together and launch an online game. \o/
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0unThQK.gif[/img]

Of course, some rare and odd cases can remain, if you are the unfortunate victim of one of thosf one of them please report it to us on Discord http://hacktag-thegame.com/discord, the Steam forums or email us at support[at]pieceofcake-studios[DOT]com

[h1]What's next: Coins, player icons, and 2 big things![/h1]
We will continue to make Hacktag better!

[b]Coins & player icons [/b]
First, note that you'll be soon able to use the Player icons and the precious coins you get from your loot safes! 
We know some of you asked us how they would be able to use those and when. We wanted to add these features sooner, but we finally preferred to focus on fixing the last bad surprises we had close to the finish line rather than offering this two cosmetic features. 
In the end, the coins and player icons will be fully integrated very soon in a next big update... which leads to speaking a little of the two big things we are preparing!

[b]The two big things [/b]
We are cooking up the next seasonal event! I won't spoil the theme just yet, but be prepared for something much bigger than the "Moonlight" release event. If you are curious you can try to worm some information out of us on discord or get some teasing on Twitter.  But that's not it, this event will not come alone, we're working on something really cool. I would love to tell you all about it right this instant, but for some reasons, I feel like vanishing and let this mysterious sentence be the last of the patch note... Stew on that. 


[h1]Patch note version 1.0.2f3[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fix: The guards' behaviors in C.L.A.W Media levels in medium difficulty have been fixed: the guards now go back to its normal patrol after an alert.
[*] Fix: A guard and antivirus are now alerted every time after failing an alarm mini-game
[*] The agent can now correctly interact with alarm in maps #02850713 #02B7F99
[*] Jails have now the proper behaviors in map #001FEAB
[/list]
See you hackers!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/39d454697000547fa568b67bdb9ea01597eb9842.png[/img]

notes.title: So... servers went down, here's the story
notes.notes:
When your game is named Hacktag, apparently some would think this is a call for a hacking contest on our game. ;)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pIK8zze.gif[/img]

Yesterday we had troubles with our servers that prevented you to play Hacktag for a couple of hours, so here's the reason: 

We have been hacked! 
Well not a big hack, just a smart player who wanted to exploit a bug to get all unlockable items & skills. This hacktager decided to add more than 50000 unlockables to his character and ... surprise ... the servers really didn't appreciate that at all.

We were told quickly of the issue and we worked late to restablish the sanity of our servers. Now, hopefully, everything is back to normal

What have we learnt from that? 
First of all, our community is really kind, full of comprehensive & patient players. They were very supportive while we were working on the servers and cheered & supported us on our Discord server. Thank you!
Secondly, it's not a secret we are a small dev team, we have a small community but even that facts given, we have to manage our servers and our tech like big companies do. This is hard, we don't have the same resources, but everyday we are improving our tech and fixing the remaining issues.

Could this happen again?
Yes! Even if we identified the cause of the issue and we are working on fix to avoid the same exploit. We already know that we can't defeat hackers... and we are not even interested to do so, and you know what? we find this quite cool... please, just don't break the game for other people! 
So we will just make it less obvious for sly players to exploit our flaws, and we will fix every new bug exploit we could be aware of.

Well, that's all for now, we just wanted to tell you what happened. We hope you were not too frustrated if you wanted to play Hacktag yesterday evening with your bff, bae or your bro! That said, sorry for the inconvenience!

Note to hackers: please don't loop over 500, there is nothing more to unlock after that... for now! ;)

See ya!

notes.title: Update #37 version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello, hackers!
 
Well, it has been a rather long full moon night!
After 8 days, the moonlight event is over and so is launch week!
Don't be sad, we have many seasonal events in stock. And if you didn't get to unlock one of the special items, there is still a minor chance to randomly find one in a safe.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/9a1a0a6d78b549180ee0f511b60f82a6bda92e6e.gif[/img]

So let's get down to business: the update. Many players have joined us this past weekend (hey there, welcome!) which has had the logical and yet annoying consequence to uncover some types of connection and configuration our online code wasn't quite dealing with properly. Thanks to your reports, our small but valiant team has been solving new issues every day. Here are today's fixes and improvements: 


[h1]Patch-note: update #37 - version 1.0.1[/h1]

[*] Fix: Players with the same local IP won't be disconnected anymore while connecting together.
[*] Fix: To prevent progression loss after losing connection, there is now an automatic reconnection system to save the player state.
[*] Fix: When the guards are on seek state, they are now alerted by footsteps sounds.
[*] Fix: You can now slam a door in a guard's face when he is in chase mode.  
[*] Fix: The hacker can now open every jail door with the "Free your partner" mini-game. (it wasn't always triggered properly.)
[*] Fix: You can now increase the sensitivity of the hacker "guide" to assist you in moving and avoid unwanted moves. (see the options menu)
[*] You now unlock a "grey hat' skin when you finish your story as a grey hat hacker.
[*] Fix: Blocking bug of the hacker that couldn't be liberated from an IDS is fixed.
[*] Fix: The Mainframe raid objective bar is now correctly placed in every case.
[*] Fix: Previously selected skills are now always kept in memory before starting a new mission.
[*] Fix: The agent is not able to accidentally interrupt the "avoid the lasers mini-games" of the hacker by entering into another room.
[*] Fix: The "halo mini-game feedback" is now always visible (it wasn't always the case after switching roles).
[*] Fix: Some UI issues with misplaced elements in wide screen resolutions have been fixed.

(NB: since I wanted to avoid spamming you with 2 many patch notes, you'll find here the list of the patches merged in one, it includes today's version 1.0.1 and also 1.0.0f7 pushed on Feb 20th.)

Alright that's it for today, see you soon hackers!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/39d454697000547fa568b67bdb9ea01597eb9842.png[/img]

notes.notes: Hacktag, the two-player cooperative stealth game where one player is a field agent sneaking around megacorp facilities and the other’s a hacker jacking the building’s datanet, is now properly out. notes.notes:

Hello Hackers!

The game in version 1.0  is 1 day old and that means it's time for the famous day one patch! Some of you reported on Discord a few urgent issues we immediately fixed. Thanks again for this! You may find the list of this first batch of fixes at the end of the post..

In addition, some of you may have experienced some connection issues yesterday for under an hour. We had confirmation this was due to server work on Steam's side which prevented our own server from authenticating player accounts during this time (awesome timing with our launch day, amirite? ). But now everything should be hunky-dory. :)

[h1] Moonlight event: Hack in style![/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/9a1a0a6d78b549180ee0f511b60f82a6bda92e6e.gif[/img]

You might not have noticed yet, but Hacktag is a pretty accurate reconstitution of industrial spies' daily life. We've spent many months observing them in their natural habitat during the pre-production of the game and let me tell ya, if there is one thing to know about those very secretive people, it is that they love to sneak in and hack in style!  

This is why you can unlock these very fancy items during the all the Lunar New Year and Valentine's day period.


[h1]Patch-note: update #34 - version 1.0.0f3[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fix: You're not stuck in infinite connecting after inviting a friend to play a mission anymore.
[*] Fix: The hacker is no longer stuck after being liberated between nodes during an escort.
[*] Fix: As a Hacker, you can now press F key to cancel your movement
[*] Fix: You cannot move anymore in  character selection while in connecting status (a blocking bug could occur in some cases if you moved.)
[*] Fix: The data-scavenger boss mini-game and one of the co-op door mini-game have been fixed. A blocking bug may appear in some cases.
[*] Fix: Controls with a PS4 gamepad are fixed.
[*] Fix: Level design fixes: the netlinks after a firewall are now correctly faded on every map.
[*] Fix: Level design fixes on several maps #00111ECO (Genethics) #001070C9
[*] Fix: We also made some boring fixes to improve the server capacity and stability. 
[/list]

notes.title: Hacktag is now out with a - 25% launch week discount!
notes.notes:
Happy Valentine's day, hackers!

Well, this is it. After 8 great months of Early Access, Hacktag is finally and officially released right on time for a (b)romantic date under... the moonlight.
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/a257a70aa887d7e693e2d11dfa664edcb98be502.png[/img]

Let me explain. Not only is Hacktag coming out today with 9 different stories to discover and many improvements, but it also comes out with a surprise special event, "Moonlight". 
 
And who says special event, says special unlockable items! Launch week is the occasion to grab some special items inspired by Valentine's Day and the lunar year (what a perfect match!). I know, I know. You desperately want to sneak in and steal a bunch of data while rocking those ridiculous, ahem, I mean ridiculously cool heart-shaped sunglasses. 

If you are new in Hacktag - first and foremost thank you and welcome - you will quickly notice that we love changing it up with seasonal events like this one. 

[h1] Newcomers: welcome to Hacktag! :D [/h1]
Congratulations! We think you have excellent taste and we truly hope you have tons of fun playing our game. Sneaking into those corporations might be stressful and challenging, but it is mostly fun and exciting! For now, just start exploring the game and let the fun begin. We will get back to you to tell you more about the final version content very soon (believe it or not, but things have been a bit crazy at the studio lately!). 

In the meantime, if you would like to chat with the dev team, meet new players or just say hi, you are always welcome on [url=http://hacktag-thegame.com/discord]Hacktag's official discord server.[/url] 
You can also follow us [url=https://twitter.com/HacktagTheGame]on social media [/url] and watch [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CufeyuYQnEA]the new launch trailer[/url] we've made!  

[img]https://i.imgur.com/p65z1xq.gif[/img]
Talk to you soon, hackers, now we vanish!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/39d454697000547fa568b67bdb9ea01597eb9842.png[/img]

notes.title: Update #32: New mission type: Mainframe Raid
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/760a61f69eb49a05a74d58c4a9c62a66effc429b.png[/img]

9 days left before Hacktag final release and we're not done with the updates!
Yes, you read this right! While we are working on polishing the game and greedily overkilling it with last-minute features, we wanted to offer you one last consistent plate of new content before the release. Showtime!


[h1]New mission type: Mainframe Raid[/h1]

After [b]Data Scavenger[/b] and [b]Boss Takedown[/b], here it is, the third mission type! 
In a [b]Mainframe Raid[/b], the hackers must get an access to the corporation's mainframe either to steal or corrupt the precious data. 

But the mainframe database is divided into 3 mainframe units protected by a 4 symbol password. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/2b4073f3ab10ea125bd74cec847e49673c85e860.png[/img]

First, you will have to explore the office to locate the computers that are concealing one of the symbols and hack them in the right order.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pOEACWC.gif[/img]

When this is done, find both your way to the appropriate mainframe unit and enter the password together!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fgg42hJ.gif[/img]

We really like this new mission type as rushing on the computers to find which one contains a symbol or not is quite exhilarating. But beware, it can get chaotic quickly once you have found them all, but you can't recall where they are! ;)

Again same as with the previous mission type: please,[b]give us you feedback and report your issues[/b]. Let us know if you experience bugs or any understanding issues regarding the interface of this mission type. We really need your feedback.


[h1]Many gameplay improvements[/h1]
This update also includes some improvements we have been wanting to add for a loooong time - Well pretty much since the beginning actually - and we have no doubt this will make your experience much more enjoyable.

[b]Visual feedback on covers[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3ky9FbS.gif[/img]
The most frequent feedback we've had from you is that it is hard to know when you are hidden or not when playing the agent. Clearly this may lead to frustrating situations. With this new visual feedback you can now directly see where you'll be covered and also when the cover isn't safe anymore.

[b]Agent is now outlined when behind an obstacle[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hKfw21b.gif[/img]
Sometimes, you could easily lose sight of your agent when trying a tricky sneaking move close to a wall. This visual feedback will definitely help you! 

[h1]Graphics improvements: different facades for each corps.[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0djWw8y.gif[/img]
When creating Hacktag universe, we always considered the corporations as a special character, with their own agenda & personality. With today's update, we reinforce their differences and aesthetics by adding exterior facades to their buildings.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HAyHess.gif[/img]

C. L. A. W. Media group gets a very urban and art-deco facade, Lexyk is more of a company set in lofts, while Genethics is looking like a periurban pharmaceutical company.

[h1]Tons of improvements, tweaking and bugs fix[/h1]

This update also comes with a lot of fixes and adjustments as you can see in the patch note below:

[h1]2018-02-03 Changelist - Early Access version v0.18.0f1[/h1]
[list]
[b]New content[/b]
[*]New mission type: Mainframe Raid.
[*]Different exterior facades for each corporation.
[*]Level design balancing and tweaking on every map.

[b]Gameplay improvementst[/b]
[*]Covers now have a visual feedback.
[*]The agent is now outlined when behind an obstacle.
[*]The chances to get rare items in safes are higher.
[*]Using the invisibility skill when you are escorted to jail now sets you free.
[*]There is now a feedback to inform you of the range of the jailbreak skill.
[*]It is now easier to disable an antivirus when it  is escorting the hacker to an IDS.
[*]You can now use the right stick to scroll up and down in the menus.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]

[*]Slamming a door directly after the agent got caught no longer lets the player stuck in hands up position.
[*]The countdown of an agent jail is now always stopped after hacking the jail door.
[*]Difficulty of the level is now correctly displayed in the game.
[*]The score of the agent and the hacker are now correctly displayed online on both sides.
[*]The character name of each character is now always correctly displayed in character selection menu.
[*]Single player: the two sticks were controlling the same player in the co-op door mini-game.
[*]Various bug fixes on maps #0027877, #206108
[*]Single player:  you don't see anymore the agent icon in agent view.
[*]Single player: you can now use the two sticks to quickly finish a boss takedown minigame.
[*]Single player: you can't control the menu if a second controller is on.
[*]The alarm and co-op door mini-game panel don't stay open after quitting it anymore.
[*]The agent can't move anymore during the co-op door mini-game.
[*]The agent movement is now blocked when hacking a firewall or a scanner.
[*]When a mini-game is canceled you take back the control of the character before the panel is fully closed.
[*]The water tanks in Genethics now have the right color.
[*]You cannot use the invisibility skill to go through a jail door anymore.
[*]When the other player is disconnected you are directly sent to the main menu without seeing an empty 3d scene in between.
[*]When you are stealing data, you always see the panel with progression bar. ( it wasn't displayed in rare cases).
[*]In online game: you can now choose your skills after switching roles.
[*]The interaction issues with the IDS have been fixed.
[*]Many graphics optimizations.

Well, that's pretty much it for the Mainframe Raid update!

And remember Hacktag launches February 14th, so save the date for a gamer date!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/39d454697000547fa568b67bdb9ea01597eb9842.png[/img]

notes.title: Co-op stealth game Hacktag sneaking onto Steam February 14
notes.notes:
Hacktag is a two-player co-op stealth game about two spies from rival agencies working together to infiltrate corporations. It's set in "a parallel world inhabited by anthropomorphic animals," and launched on Steam Early Access last summer. Today, developer Piece of Cake Studios announced its offical release date: February 14, 2018. 

You can play Hacktag solo by swapping between the two spies, but like Piece of Cake itself, the game was built from the ground up with co-op in mind. It supports local and online co-op, as well as online challenges and leaderboards. One player puts their boots on the ground as the Agent, opening doors and air vents and slipping unnoticed past guards. The other player is the Hacker, who collects information and manipulates mainframes and other spy stuff to help the Agent progress. 

"While some tasks can be accomplished by either player, many tasks require the cooperation of both," Piece of Cake says. "For instance, opening a locked door requires the Hacker to electronically unlock it while the Agent physically opens it."

Hacktag is currently available for $20. Its price will not increase upon exiting Early Access. In fact, it will be on sale for $15 the week of its release.

notes.notes:

notes.title: Update #30: single player mode improved!
notes.notes:
Hello hackers!

I hope you are having fun trying the new solo mode! 
You know, this solo mode has changed our lives as game developers to a point you cannot fathom. When you have the great idea to create a studio dedicated to making co-op games, you don't necessarily anticipate that, in your daily life, you'll have to test the co-op features you are developing...alone.   

For the last 2 years, not a single day has passed without one of us loudly dropping a controller on the ground while testing the game. But with the solo mode, these days are gone! No more clumsy attempts to switch controllers at light speed and a significantly reduced budget dedicated to gamepad replacements (hopefully!). That's something!

Now let's talk about the update!

This one is improving the solo experience and also debugging some general features.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/g8We6Vs.gif[/img]


[h1]2018-01-16 Changelist - Early Access version v0.17.1f1[/h1]
[list]
[h1] Solo gameplay [/h1]
[*] When one character is activating a co-op game point, it will be activated as well if the other is already at the meeting point.
[*] Controls with mouse have been improved: there are no more latency issues when switching role while playing the agent
[*] The animated split-screen effect when changing view effect is now smoother
[*]  There is now help texts for the switch role controls.
[*] In the lobby, the small blue arrow shown to select the mission with a 2nd player, is not displayed anymore.
[*] FIX: There is now only one Start button in skill selection menu.
[*] FIX: You cannot use active skill of the character you are not controlling
[*] FIX: You can use the arrows on the keyboard to control 2nd character alarm minigame (wires).
[*] The End level minigame (boss takedown and data scavenge) is more user-friendly: no need to switch role to finish the other character sequence.

[h1] General [/h1]
[*] The difficulty of the level is displayed during the mission.
[*]FIX: fixed some infinite connections
[*]FIX: fixed progression of characters
[*]FIX: Issues when playing online and switching roles (ex: better controls with mouse)
[*]FIX: In maps #00111EC0 #1121984  the data are now correctly looted
[*]FIX: When holding use while interacting with a firewall or a radar with the agent, there is no more confusing a loading bar for 0.5s on the panel.
[*]FIX: the blocking situation were doors couldn't be hacked and opened if there have been a trapped room just before is fixed.
[*]FIX: Lighting of the map #1234567 has been improved.

[h1] Interface[/h1]
[*] Lighting and graphics optimization.
[*]FIX: The countdown when launching agame now ends at 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, every time.
[*] FIX: Some keys were considered as menu input when adding a name in the friendslist.
[*] FIX: Lighting of the characters in menus have been balanced.
[*] FIX: The seed number of the levels weren't properly displayed.

That's it for today guys!If you haven't tried the solo yet, we made [url=https://twitter.com/HacktagTheGame/status/952216288931262464] a small video[/url]  to explain the controls. And if you have try it, let us know what you think about it on ! [url=http://hacktag-thegame.com/discord]Discord[/url].

See you!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/39d454697000547fa568b67bdb9ea01597eb9842.png[/img]

notes.title: Try Hacktag brand new single player mode right now!
notes.notes:
SURPRISE!

That's right, you read the title correctly, today we are very happy to announce you that...

[h1][b]HACKTAG NOW  HAS A SINGLE PLAYER MODE![/b][/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ioWKl8f.gif[/img]

We have kept the secret as longer as possible, only some very persistent folks twisted our arm to get this information from us [url=http://hacktag-thegame.com/discord]on Discord[/url], but now it's real.
 You can now play the game on your own and get twice the stress just for yourself [b]by instant switching between the 2 roles Agent and Hacker[/b]. 

[h1]EARLY VERSION: We need your feedback![/h1]
The single player mode is still in development, but we decided to go ahead and let you play it so we can use your suggestions and feedback to polish it. If you have some ergonomics requests, balancing issues in some levels, please feel free [url=http://hacktag-thegame.com/discord]to report[/url] it to us. After all, this is one of the best things about Early-access!

Considering that the single player mode doesn't contain a dedicated tutorial for now, here is a little recap of how it works:

[b][h1] PLAY THE AGENT AND THE HACKER[/h1][/b]
In solo mode, you still create and pick two characters, your agent and your hacker with their own XP and skills,  just like in the co-op modes...But you will control both characters.

[b][h1][b]PRESS TAB TO SWITCH ROLE[/b][/h1][/b]
You always start a game on the split-screen view and you can switch between the two roles by [b] pressing TAB or LT/L2.[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ERFyrzw.gif[/img]

[h1][b]HOLD TAB TO CHANGE VIEW[/b][/h1]
Of course, the solo mode also allows to change from the split-screen view to a full screen when you [b]hold tab or TB[/b]. In this view, you can also switch from agent to hacker, with a very cool animated split-screen effect just like in old Brian de Palma movies. (the older movie addicts among will know what I'm talking about.) 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fyXdVqL.gif[/img]

[h1][b]GIVE BASIC ORDERS TO 2ND CHARACTER [/b][/h1]
The communication system used to ping your partner when playing online will be used here to give a "go to" order to the character you're not controlling. That's pretty handy you'll see. Just beware of the enemy on their way! ;)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CbTKBPi.gif[/img]

[h1][b]SWITCH ROLE WHEN YOU STEAL DATA[/b][/h1]
Pro-tip: When you hold USE button to steal data and switch role during the download, the character will keep stealing the data while you can move with the other one. We let you imagine the skill it needs to optimize your way into an open-space in order to loot all the data as quickly as possible. ;)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/g8We6Vs.gif[/img]

[h1][b]That's it! Now try it and give us your feedback [/b][/h1]
Again, since this is an early version of the game mode, we really need your help to improve it.  Report us your suggestions and issues [url=http://hacktag-thegame.com/discord]on Discord[/url] and the forum, we will make good use of them.

You'll quickly see that it is a pretty different approach from Hacktag's original gameplay, but it is really cool and it actually works far better than we expected! It is a really cool way to practice the levels, learn the patrol of guards and ultimately, dazzle your partner with your crazy skills when playing the co-op modes. 

We had been playing with the idea of a solo mode for a long time, but it probably wouldn't have been possible had we not decided to enter Early-Access.  So thank you Early-Access and thank YOU for playing it!

Of course, we will always consider the co-op gameplay as the core experience for Hacktag and we will keep working on improving it in the coming weeks. But still, we are very happy to add this new line in the Hacktag Steam store page!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/de15ac37bf17a2154d2cf68fa06849ca8977b928.png[/img]

[h1] Wait! There's more![/h1]
The update also comes with a new character creation and customization interface. We didn't have time to finish properly when the menu arrived during Winter hacker but here it is!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/w9H3fsm.gif[/img]

[h1]2018-01-12 Changelist - Early Access version v0.17[/h1]
[list][*] New solo mode.
[*] New character creation and customisation interface
[*] New co-op mini-games ergonomy (can control both roles windows during solo mode)
[*] Textures optimizations in menu.
[*] Help and controls screens when pressing start have been updated 
[/list]
Have fun with this mode and beware that now, if you get caught, there won't be anyone to blame but yourself! ːsteamhappyː

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/39d454697000547fa568b67bdb9ea01597eb9842.png[/img]

notes.title: Blog: So long 2017 and last days to get Hacktag at Early-bird price!
notes.notes:
As we are about to bid farewell to the Winter Hacking event and Hacktag is getting into the groove of 2018, let's talk about the future of the game. But first:

 [h1]A little look back at 2017[/h1]

Hacktag has now been on Early-Access for 6 months. During this time, there have been more than 26 updates including 4 major ones and thanks to your support, suggestions, and complaints (yes, we like those too) we can say that Hacktag has become a much bigger game than what we imagined two years ago! For the anecdote, the Hacktag we had in your mind had only 2 playable characters and no couch-coop mode! 

[b]Here is the version of the game 2 years ago:[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/i5oZfzI.gif[/img]

[b]And here how it is today: [/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/300474c77ad2cd8596cf174ee8c5ab4ae86a399b.gif[/img]
Yeah, there are a couple of differences. (And my gif making skills have improved.)

And now Hacktag is counting 12 playable characters versus 4 at the start of E.A and triple the number of levels by publishing a new map every week during the first 4 months. In the meantime, we managed to get rid of the very annoying online bugs we suffered at the beginning while polishing and adding content almost every week.

[h1]Hacktag price will soon increase[/h1]
At this point, the major part of the development is done and Hacktag already contains hours of co-op fun and many opportunities to get stressed and yell at each other.  (You're welcome ;) )

As we announced at the start of the Early-Access period, the price of the game would increase during the development and this is why we want to announce that the time has come. You have a few days left to get Hacktag at its old price [b]14,99 USD/EUR before it changes to the final price 19,99 USD/EUR at the end of the week [/b] (or the corresponding price depending on your regional currency.)

So if you are following the game, but don't have it in your Steam library yet, now would be a good time to get it ;)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/d6c0b41c6a6245ca21b1b9f6b910036fd00c19f8.jpg[/img]

[h1]What's next for 2018[/h1]

Obviously, the price changing won't be the only new thing for Hacktag this month and the new price will not come alone. We want to keep you on your toes a little longer, but rest assured we will keep adding more content, including some of the things that you requested the most, probably even more than the foxes! I know, the suspense is thrilling, I have a masters degree in cliffhangers. :p

See you very soon for the next update ;)


PS : Just a friendly reminder, you have only a few hours to get your paws on all the winter hacking items!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/39d454697000547fa568b67bdb9ea01597eb9842.png[/img]

notes.title: Update #26: First patch of the year!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/f238fde9bcdf2a7c6ea9ee4a190df41bc2e3c9d7.jpg[/img]

Hello Hackers! 

First and foremost, we would like to wish you all a very happy new year!

[i] (For a better experience, you may want to read these few next lines with your best "award winner speech voice". Just picture yourself picking up an Oscar and read this.)[/i]

[b]Thanks to all of all of you, 2017 has been an amazing year. [/b]
We would like to thank every person who contributed a successful year 2017 which we will always remember as one of the most intense of our lives. So thank you to not only all the nice people we've met all along the gaming events, but also those who greenlighted our game, and of course YOU, our dear early-access players who have been supporting Hacktag and helped us improve it. 

 Best wishes from all of us at Piece of Cake and looking forward to hacking 2018 together!

([i] you can now resume your normal reading tone [/i])

[h1]Now let's talk about the update![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/4a9924e11b2f9deb39fc0359e71d290633559093.jpg[/img]

As mentioned in the post dedicated to the Winter Hacking update, we have been trying to add as many things as possible in a very short amount of time, like the new user interface for instance. Unfortunately, that brought some bugs that this patch is fixing. Yay!

[h1]2017-01-04 Changelist - Early Access version v0.16.0f4[/h1]
[list]
[h1] New Interface: [/h1]
    [*]Global performance optimization.
    [*]fix: in online mode, player 2 start button now displays state (waiting, ready).
    [*]fix: The buttons (ready/next/start) now have the same size and position along the different screens navigation ( from mission select to skill select).
    [*]fix: You can now launch a local game with controllers or keyboards and not mouse only.
    [*]fix When online player "guest" is back to lobby (after a win/lost game or using back to lobby menu) he now sees the 3d models of the characters.
    [*] New animation when opening skills selection menu and going back to choose mission menu (in the lobby).
    [*] The characters now have names of different colors depending on their role.
    [*] fix: display of some background 3d scenes weren't what they should have been 
   [*] fix: The selection mission interface in tutorial have been improved.(less confusing)

[h1]Various[/h1]
    [*]fix: You now unlock the right item after opening a loot safe.
    [*]fix: No more duplicated rewards when it has been already unlocked
    [*]fix: As a hacker, there is now a "jailbreak" fx when using a continue to be released from an IDS.
    [*]fix: The localized tutorial text has now buttons icons correctly displayed.
    [*]fix: Some achievements couldn't be earned (ex: Steal 1tb data).
    [*]fix: Some achievements texts have been rewritten to make it more easily understandable (character customization & 1st boss takedown mission).
[/list]

That's it for this update! But don't worry, you will have some news from Hacktag very soon. We have some very exciting stuff coming up...
But for now, the clock is ticking! You have 4 days left to try to unlock as many winter items as possible. And trust me, you don't want to miss that grinch skin!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/a1098cdef60680294d151768bb6ad7673252e9c6.jpg[/img]

See you later hackers and happy new year again!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/39d454697000547fa568b67bdb9ea01597eb9842.png[/img]

I won't lie, we stuffed a lot of things into this update and it has been a quite of a challenge! But we really wanted to offer you a big fat menu full of improvements, bug fixes and new content for the holidays, so here we are! 
We hope you'll enjoy discovering what we have cooked for you. And today's menu starts with...

[b][h1]New user Interface[/h1][/b]

For starters, let's talk about the first thing you'll notice: the user interface of the game has been redesigned. it comes with a completely new ergonomy based on your feedback. The navigation has been facilitated, especially in the selection mission lobby.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/a7674e46b09e798176151e8e6df299d3e5097679.gif[/img]


We will keep polishing the new interface during the following weeks so don’t hesitate in providing feedbacks and bugs reports through our discord channel Thank you!

[b][h1]The Winter Hacking update[/h1][/b]
Now, let's talk about the main course:
As announced last week, from today until January 8th, Hacktag celebrates the end of the year festivities with a special event. It contains new customisable elements and contents that you can only unlock during this period.

[b][h1]Winter Hacking periodic special content:[/h1][/b]

[u][b]12 Special Hacking Winter skins +  5 accessories.[/b][/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/f62ee597f224314d915a445a917e9470de028001.gif[/img]
So far my favorite are the Grinch Raccoon and Red-nosed hind, what about yours? 


[u][b]A Christmas Special short story: [/b][/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/8e9edfb6daeab51aa73ebd29b3cb7b55cef90756.gif[/img]
This is a new thing we really wanted to offer you in this season of cheer and Christmas magic. In other words *Spoiler alert*: [spoiler]There is a big red guy who could use the help of experimented hackers... ;) [/spoiler]


[u][b]Every levels are decorated:[/b][/u]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pibbOet.gif[/img]
We haven't decorated our offices at Piece of cake studios, but we did it for the 24 levels of the game! I hope you'll enjoy this new atmosphere, but don't be fooled, avoiding a guard is still stressful, even when sneaking around a Christmas tree!

And now let's talk about the desert, The Winter Hacking update also brings many improvements that will remain after the event. 

[b][h1]The New permanent content:[/h1][/b]

[u][b]New characters: [/b][/u] 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/i4ZqOrr.gif[/img]
That's right, the foxes are finally here! it brings the total of playable character to 12. We know a lot of you were waiting for this very special animal so our artistic team studied foxes undercover, disguised as one of them and living in their lair for weeks. It was tough, but we think it was worth it.


[u][b]A continue system: [/b][/u] 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/70ddcd9b675285ac4dfff0274eaf248c34e03907.gif[/img]
With this update,  we not only did a lot of tweaking on the levels  (collisions and enemies patrols) we have also added a « continue ». After a failure, you will now be able to escape from a jail "for free". Of course, using these continues slightly downgrades your score (otherwise it'll be less fun huh ? ;) )


[u][b]New reward system: the safe loots. [/b][/u] 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OOWiA39.gif[/img]
We've built a more complete and satisfying reward system. After each mission success, you gain enough C4 to make that big safe explode! 
It will unlock 3 new customizations elements each time. Such as skins and accessories among others.
Of course, these items are completely free and can be earned only by playing (and winning the mission ;).)


[u][b]Graphics improvements: the facades. [/b] [/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/4862ea705a12a4fa3c261414bff547cbfb232f5c.gif[/img]
We really wanted to show this for Christmas but for optimizations purposes, it is only available in high and highest quality settings, we will also bring more facades variety in the following days. 

[u][b]42 Steam Achievements:[/b][/u] 
 AAAAAAAAAaaaaaah finally, achievements. I love those things.
And now, I can finally get rid of my food metaphor by telling what do we have for the digestive...
 
[h1]A new "Winter hacking" trailer:[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/fdb7164d48d57ec243de451d7f379adaab9dc3db.jpg[/img]
For the occasion, we made a special trailer that teases a part of this new content 

You can [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F5Szfv8dRoE] watch it here[/url], you can offer it to your friends who doesn't know Hacktag yet! ;)

[h1]2017-12-20 Changelist v0.16- Early Access[/h1]

[list]
[h1]General :[/h1]
[*] Winter Hacking special content (1 story mission, 12 skins & 5 items to unlock)
[*]New reward system: the safe loots. 
[*]42 Steam Achievements
[*]2 new characters: foxes
[*]Continue system 
[*]104 unlockable player icons (you will be able to set them as profile pic very soon)
[*] The texts of the tutorial have been improved.
[/list]

[list]
[h1]Controls :[/h1]
[*] Controls of the agent with mouse improved. Double clicks make you run and you go back to walk if click once.
[*] Controls on the keyboard have been also improved. (you can now choose among different controls ) 
[*] In the tutorial the control buttons are now displayed correctly according to your controller (keyboard, PS4 or Xboxone gamepad)
[*] Fix: Control with mouse fixed,  the character doesn't move away when the player clicks on wall or on outside the level[/list]

[list][h1]Graphics: [/h1]
[*] New menu (character creation + selection, mission lobby, score screen, and rewards.)
[*] Every level is decorated for the Holiday season
[*] 1 type of facades available in high & highest graphics settings.  
[/list]

[list][h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[*]  Fix: Level design: every collision around desks and furniture have been improved.
[*] Fix: World leaderboard are not displayed when going to next pages 
[*] Fix: trapped room bug: when a player is in minigame to open door and the other player trigger a trap room including this door, beating the minigame wasn't opening the door
[*] Fix: The invisibility skill can only be triggered once.
[/list]

We hope you'll enjoy this Winter hacking update, and of course, the whole Piece of Cake studios Team is behind my back right now (I swear) to wish you a great end of the year!

notes.title: Version 0.15.2f1 is now available
notes.notes:
Hello Hackers,

This week patch is mainly about improving and fixing remaining network issues, but also tutorial & local games issues that have been caused by  the use of the new network technologies.
In previous patches, we added new network technologies to allow players who weren't able to connect to each other (mainly due to blocking firewalls). Things went well, but obviously it created some unforeseen conflicts with the existing technology for some of you because, hey, what fun would it be without complications? But we are now getting to the end of the road for that matter and this update will prevent most of the issues encountered during the past weeks. 

Of course, if you still experience issues, please  [url=http://hacktag-thegame.com/discord] contact us on Discord [/url] & include as many details as possible as it helps us to make a better game and besides all, because we want you to play the game! :D

And again, we are really sorry for the inconvenience caused by this, the fixes took far more time than expected! We thank you a lot for your patience and understanding!

Here is the patch note :

[h1]2017-12-06 Changelist v0.15.2f1 - Early Access [/h1]

[h1] General: [/h1]
[list]
[*] You cannot unlock the autumn sales special items anymore. (sorry guys!)
[*] Fixed: some already existing characters weren't properly displayed nor customizable
[*] Fixed the fact that after a 'player 2' played with the keyboard in local play the 'player 1' couldn't use it again in the main menu
[*] Now you can select your character and join properly an online game after the end of a game played through friend invitation.
[*] When we detect that the game resolution is wrong (not visible), we reset it automatically.
[*] Fixed bugs in the interface caused by the upgrade of our game engine, some could have been blocking
[*] Fixed leaderboard not loading fresh data because of the regional settings other than ones compatible with EN/US settings.
[*] Slightly better performance ingame than the version 0.15.2. But there is still some work remaining.
 [/list]

[h1] Gameplay: [/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Jailbreaker skill preventing mini-game for the IDS to be triggered. (blocking bug)
 [/list]

[h1] Tutorial:  [/h1]
[*] In tutorial, quitting the password mini-game with the A.I is no longer definitive.
[*] Fixed a bug on the hacker medal in the tutorial

 [/list]
[h1] Network: [/h1]
[*] The use matching of players in online games should be easier, and the best technologies are now selected for the connections.
[*] Add proper usage of different network technologies to match players online: direct, uPnP, NAT-Punchthrough, relay servers
[*] Fixed a conflict between the use of NAT-Punchthrough and direct connection technologies that was causing the NAT-Punchthrough to be always selected.
[*] Fixed a conflict between the use of NAT-Punchthrough and direct connection technologies that was causing an infinite connection wait.
[*] Fixed access to tutorial and local games for players with regional settings other than ones compatible with EN/US settings.
[*] Fixed disconnections while entering a map in online games, bug introduced with version 0.15.2
Now that network connectivity must be better for most of you, we can focus again on gameplay, features and content!
If you still encounter such issues, please join our discord server at http://www.hacktag-thegame.com/discord for live chat and direct support!

By the way, do you know why our team is called Piece of Cake studios?
[url=https://twitter.com/PoC_studios/status/936272492523675648]Check this out! [/url]

Laterz Hackerz!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/39d454697000547fa568b67bdb9ea01597eb9842.png[/img]
