notes.title: Update #18: A wild patch appears!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Hackers![/h1]
 
Hackoween is done, Paris Games Week is done but we are nowhere near done with Hacktag! \o/
This week we mainly bring you fixes and optimizations that will improve the online experience and the navigation in the menus. We also worked on tweaking and balancing the easy level of difficulty for all 24 maps. It will make the experience closer to the difficulty level we are aiming for the game.

This patch also adds a feature asked by many players which give the ability to create up to 6 characters. It will now be more convenient if you play with several partners or just enjoy all the animal species and customization elements you unlock.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/876f9a6a22924cf93d59684d5c1136a1ad866de2.gif[/img]


[h1]2017-11-17 Changelist v0.15f1 - Early Access [/h1]
 
[*] Online matchmaking and connection fixed. Players had an infinite connection to another player due to issues with IPv6
[*] Big menu optimizations. (less memory used.)
[*] More character slots added. You can now create 6 characters. (community suggestion)
[*] Fix:  Level design fixes on map #6787621 (objective was attainable before the end of the level).
[*] Rebalancing all 24 maps in the easy difficulty level.
[*] Fix:   when stealing data, releasing the download button at 100% no longer causes a fail.
[*] Fix: some broken links in the menus are now correctly linked.
[*] Fix: stopping an antivirus while escorting the hacker can no longer block the hacker on the node.
[*] Fix: with the "laser vision skill" the antiviruses are no longer white for the agent.
[*] Fix: The menu icons were not all set for PS4 controllers.
[*] Fix: Hacker teleporting SFX now appears properly
[*] Fix: the guard and antivirus exclamation and interrogation marks have now the correct color feedback and behavior.
[*] Fix:  The "gear" feedback now appears properly when opening a door online.
[*] Fix: several level design fixes (colliders.)
[*] Fix: tagged nodes behavior fixed. The tagged nodes were removed from the sidebar in HUD, but were still tagged in reality (online)
[*] Fix: The agent doesn't trigger an automatic dialog bubble when he deactivates an antivirus.
[*] Fix: The guards aren't alerted anymore if you successfully finish the alarm mini-game at the last second.
[*] Fix: Leaving a boss takedown mini-game and launching it again no longer causes issues. (blocking bug)
 
That's all for the upgrades. Now if you haven't read it yet, we published earlier this week a little recap of everything that happened around Hacktag this past month. You can check it on [url=http://www.pieceofcake-studios.com/previously-on-piece-of-cake-studios.] Piece of Cake Studio’s blog[/url].

Laterz Hackerz!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/39d454697000547fa568b67bdb9ea01597eb9842.png[/img]

notes.title: Hackoween special update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/70814d396413499adc9f2fd9881249dabc2ba74d.jpg[/img]


[h1]Happy Hackoween*! Hacktag dons its Halloween costume![/h1]

That's right guys, for a few days only, you can sneak in and steal industrial intel with a jack 'o lantern hat because to hell with logic!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/7a125d1422901b21ec7177bcadb48fb39b4e622f.gif[/img]

Organizing this kind of special events in Hacktag is something we have wanted from the start, so we are very excited to offer this event.

[h1]Unlock new skins during 7 days only[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/6224d91dd39b5a7d15e24e482f8ac2a3202f47ed.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/a179f2af93fe65f81a7f1a934ce47cdc4da182bd.gif[/img]

You have until November 1st to sneak into Halloween-themed levels, unlock 10 Halloween skins and 3 accessories. And trust me, you really want the Dr. Frankeinstein's creature or the Calavera skins.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/d8b71778f8461dae705040ce4f37f676146ff88e.jpg[/img]

Of course, this Hackoween special update is not only a reskinning of the game with a Halloween theme, it also contains some cool updates and fixes based on your feedback after the Boss Takedown update release 2 days ago.  

Here is the Boss Takedown patch note: 

[h1]2017-10-26 Changelist v0.14- Early Access [/h1]
[list]
[*]New Halloween main menu 3D scenes,
[*]10 Halloween special unlockable skins,
[*]4 unlockable accessories,
[*]All 24 levels are now Halloween-themed,
[*]Fix: Boss Takedown mission updates passwords are now always synced in online mode.
[*]Fix: Multiple minor fixes on boss takedown missions
[*]Fix: Co-op mini games: character is no more stuck in "waiting state"
[*]Fix: With PS4 controllers activated, the 2nd player playing with the keyboard had issues.
[/list]

*Ps: Noticed the pun? It's "Hackoween special" instead of "Halloween" because it's a hacking game... Geddit?  Clever, eh? ;)

notes.title: Big Update : Boss takedown!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/449047b6f13460fde2724096392634f2d0cf8f47.png[/img]
It is time to take down the bosses! 

It's live! While preparing the weekly updates with the new maps and fixes, we have also been working hard to offer this much bigger update. Here is a little overview of what it contains.


[h1]A new type of mission: Boss takedown.[/h1]

In this new mode, both players must infiltrate the corporations' offices to hack the boss’ computer. However, the machine is protected by a password and each player must discover half of it unless they decide to save time and head directly to the protected computer without the password… at their own risks! This new mission type is available for the 24 existing maps, just look for the new "crown" icon on the mission selection lobby.

[h1]New co-op mini-games:[/h1]
You thought sneaking into the corporations was stressful already? Well, I have news for you guys, the corporations have increased their security. Effective immediately, each alarm you trigger and protected doors you open will be deactivated with different co-op games. And you'll never know which one you'll get of course! ;)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/f9fb2c4def004edf34870905ee2a7acf8d3ce594.gif[/img]

[h1]Booby trapped rooms:[/h1]
For this new feature, I’ll keep it short. As they say, a gif is worth a thousand words:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/53689c2a6377c0f87f6618aa975317eddd5b3d05.gif[/img]

[h1]New player characters:[/h1]
If you follow Hacktag on Twitter (and if you don’t you really should!), you may have seen some sneak peaks of these new fellow hackers along with the concept arts, but hold and behold, they are finally alive! You now have the option to play with Cats, Raccoons, Rabbits, Deer and Hyenas. They come with 2 new customizable outfits.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/81758af519195b830a801f93673cab5f258dc1dc.gif[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/fd27b4d1a88bbe1da9eb08fca8a13978925e42ae.gif[/img]

Here is the Boss takedown patch note: 
[h1]2017-10-24 Changelist v0.13- Early Access [/h1]
 
New Gameplay features: 
[list]
[*]New mission type "Boss takedown" available for the 24 levels.
[*]6 new playable characters (rabbits, hyenas, male deer and female raccoon)
[*]2 new co-op mini-games (for alarms, protected-doors).
[*]2 new co-op mini-games on the boss computer depending on the mission type.
[*]New gameplay situation: the room may be booby-trapped with lasers.
 
Improvements: 
[*]New main menu 3D scenes with all the characters.
[*]New NPC for the mentor character (in the tutorial).
[*]Better Hacker interface: new feedbacks and graphics upgrades (virtual color for furniture).
[*]Many level-design balancing and fixes.
[*]Better feedback on firewalls (scale of the icon is changing when it is opened).

Fixes: 
[*] Connection to the game in the launch menu fixed.
[*]A lot of online issues have been fixed, global stability and connectivity is improved.
[*]Many bugs after switching roles online are fixed (some are remaining, see known bugs category).

[*]Online scores between the two players are now synced.

[*]Smoke bomb skills behavior can no longer set your partner free.
[*]The music is not associated with the correct corporation.
[*]Inverted text bubbles with PS4 controller.
[*]Gamepad issues with 2 xboxone controllers and Bluetooth.


Known bugs :
[*]Doors stayed red for the agent after being hacked.
[*] New mini-games may cause some bugs (closing the panel can close the panel of your partner on another mini-game)

[/list]
[h1]Stay tunned :[/h1]

And don’t fool yourself into thinking we are done with you just yet. Even after such a plump update, we still have some tricks up our sleeves! It might just be we have a few spooky surprises coming your way pretty soon! Stay tuned!
 

Laterz' hackers!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/39d454697000547fa568b67bdb9ea01597eb9842.png[/img]

notes.title: Update #14: A small patch before... the big one!
notes.notes:
Hello Hackers!

In this week update, we're adding 2 new maps + many fixes and... a kick-ass new main menu 3d-scene! Seriously guys, take a look at this beauty : 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/a764ebbee1098d38a55a002baa69a7ed0733bea5.gif[/img]

The two new maps are set at C.L.A.W Media and Lexyk, and brace yourselves hackers! Those ones are hardcore! I know, I tell you that all the time, but really guys...be prepared. They require [url= https://twitter.com/HacktagTheGame/status/914152564949753857]some epic co-op moves[/url] with expert timing and coordination, but man! The feeling when you pass... it's something, you'll see. 

[h1] Big announcement very soon![/h1]
As you can see, the patch note this week is pretty dense with bugs fixes and improvements.In the meantime, we are also close to announcing something that is both huge and very cool. So if I was you I'd click on the "follow button" right now on Steam, you definitely don't want to miss that.

Here this week patch note : 
[h1]2017-10-22 Changelist v0.10.3f1- Early Access [/h1]
[list]

[*]  New map: Lexyk corporation seed in 3 difficulty levels (number #206108)
[*]  New map: CLAW corporation in 3 difficulty levels (number  #1FEAB )
[*]  Alarms are now randomly triggered on every map.
[*]  New 3d main menu scene with in-game characters.
[*]  1st optimization of the post-processing effects.
[*]  Character selection and lobby optimization.
[*]  Added a FX feedback when the agent is on coffee boost.
[*]  Better FX feedback when deactivating an antivirus.
[*]  Added a scale animation on the hacker hud icons when he goes in and out of the node.
[*]  New NPCs species and faces.
[*]  Failing the firewall hacking minigames now makes noise.
[*]  fix: stop antivirus on the wrong devices (you can't deactivate it anymore on co-op door, jails...)
[*]  fix: rewards weren't aligned when more than 3 and misplaced for player 2 on local mode.
[*]  fix: Sometimes the hacker couldn't get caught by antivirus after being saved during an escort.
[*]  fix: Various level design bug fixes on map #000FECE7 - (guard wasn't escorting to right jail)
[*]  fix : rendering of  the radars sprites in hacker view.
[*]  fix: navigation in the customization menu improved
[*]  fix: guard's behavior with the sound of coffee machines.
[*]  fix: gamepad issues when online, the host was able to control some player 2 panels (skills, switch roles requests...).
[*]  fix: Connectivity issues on Mac. 
[*]  fix: In local mode, to validate the deletion of a character by the player 2, the player 1 must press 'A' instead of the player 2
[*]  fix: The radar/Camera movement & FX is deactivated if the device is off (mode easy)
[*]  fix: the animation of the 2 characters in the lobby are now different.
[*]  fix:  inverted text bubbles with PS4 controller
[*]  fix: the correct role is now displayed when asking to switch role in the lobby.
[*]  fix: after switching role, it wasn't possible to choose the skills specific to the role.
[*]  fix: the blue color of the guard hologram was the same as the furniture
[*]  fix: radars were triggered by hacker when he was escorted to jail
[*]  fix: some guards antiviruses weren't escorting at the right jail/IDS.
[*]  fix: many level-design fixes on all maps.

Known bugs : 
[*] While playing online: opened doors will remain "red" for the agent.
[*] In options: choosing azerty/qwerty causes troubles.
[*] Leaving a local-play game to launch an online game could cause issues.
[*] Some disconnections may occur and force you to launch the game again.
[/list]

[h1] Some other (great) news[/h1]
[*]First, we learned this week that Hacktag is nominated for Best independent game at the annual French Ping Awards ceremony! You can check the [url=http://www.ping-awards.com/2017-nominations]ful llist of the nominees here[/url]. The ceremony will be held on November the 2nd right during the Paris Games Week.Which leads to the second news....
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/952140c190bbcde9ed65ec1168ba342d787a7fa6.jpg[/img]

[*]Hacktag will be showcased at Paris Games Week, the most important gaming event in France. If you plan to attend PGW17 come by and meet us, we will be in the "Jeux Made in France area" from November the 1st to 5th.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/07be56a153d2d197d9157109fca4a30f56937d2c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Be ready for what's coming next![/h1]
As mentioned on top, we're going to announce big thing very soon so keep an eye on  [url=https://www.facebook.com/HacktagTheGame/?ref=br_rs]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/HacktagTheGame/?ref=br_rs]Twitter[/url] frequently during the upcoming days.
 
Laterz, Hackers!
 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/39d454697000547fa568b67bdb9ea01597eb9842.png[/img]

notes.title: Update #13 : it's coffee time!
notes.notes:
Hello Hackers!

It's been two weeks since the last update, so as promised you have the chance to get two new maps! 
This update also contains a small feature we have been meaning to add: the stealth agent now gets a temporary speed boost when he drinks a coffee! I know, if only it was like this in real life am I right?

With some practice, the "coffee boost" allows some pretty epic escapes, so why not try to improve your speedrun highscore ?

The two new maps are set at C.L.A.W Media and Genethics.
There is a pretty long and tricky corridor with phones and coffee machines – which will be your best friends while the Genethics contains a place our dear level designer likes to call "the carousel of death". I let you find where it is.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/300474c77ad2cd8596cf174ee8c5ab4ae86a399b.gif[/img]

[h1]2017-09-29 Changelist v0.10.1f3- Early Access [/h1]
[list]

[*]  New map: C.L.A.W. Medias corporation seed in 3 difficulty levels (number #00006121)
[*]  New map: Genethics corporation in 3 difficulty levels (number  #0000460F)
[*]  Drinking a fresh coffee gives you a few seconds speed boost.
[*]  You can now ping your partner while waiting for him at a minigame point (alarm, co-door...)
[*]  Failing the firewall hacking minigames now makes noise.
[*]  fix: Holographic screen on the computer arm is fixed.
[*]  fix: disabled/gray "Tutorial" menu entry
[*]  fix: Various level design bug fixes on map #0093F6C7 (broken netlink for hacker)
[*]  fix: Various level fixes on map #0001E38D: coffee machine, jail collision issues.
[*]  fix: Various level fixes on map #00D03E3: coffee machine noise volume, 2 coffees machines weren't hackable, last jails issues
[*]  fix: Various level fixes on map #0027877: camera wasn't calling guards, netlink bug, guards behaviors (stuck)
[*]  fix: Various level fixes on map #00022DA1
[/list]

[h1]IndieCade is in one week![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/857a22ae889af4333817e82fba37e3bab8ecf8ab.jpg[/img]

Hacktag is part of the IndieCade Game selection next weekend! For this occasion Piece of cake studios is bringing their strong French accent to L.A. Hacktag will be exhibited on Sunday at 10 AM and Friday at 2 PM for a Game tasting session for devs and press. And if you just want to have chat with us while we aren't showcasing the game, just look for the tall dark-haired guy with a mild case of alopecia complex.

[url=http://www.indiecade.com/2017]Visit indiCade website[/url]
http://www.indiecade.com/2017
 
[h1]A sneak peek of the upcoming features[/h1]
As mentioned last week, we are preparing a lot of cool stuff for the game. Want some spoilers? 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/da05bf35a58c8dd7fbaa6754905f1b1afe28e7f5.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/4089fc2ee472192a75cba2067ea2531ecc8a5359.jpg[/img]
If you would like to discover more exclusive teasing, follow us on Hacktag's [url=https://www.facebook.com/HacktagTheGame/?ref=br_rs]Facebook page[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/HacktagTheGame/?ref=br_rs]Twitter[/url], we will give you some sneak peaks of these features. Also, we'd be happy to get your feedback about'em.
 
Laterz, Hackers!
 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/39d454697000547fa568b67bdb9ea01597eb9842.png[/img]

notes.notes:

[h1]2017-09-15 Changelist v0.10.0f2- Early Access [/h1]
[list]


[h1]NEW MAPS[/h1]

[*]   Genethics corporation seed in 3 difficulty levels (number #00D03E3)

[*]  Mentor attribution according to player species fixed

[*]  Various level design bug fixes on map #0093F6C7 (broken netlink for hacker)
[*]  Various level fixes on map #0000029A : countdown fixed on cameras.
[*]  Various level fixes on map #0076ADF1 
[*]  Various level fixes on map #009164E1 
[*]  Various level fixes on map #00787621
[*]  Various level fixes on map #0020FF1A

[/list]

On a different topic we have some cool news to share with you guys :

[h1]Hacktag is part of the IndieCade game selection![/h1]

The festival dates are October 6 - 8, 2017, if you are planning to to attend, we'd be happy to meet your in person. See you in October L.A!

notes.title: New map and many bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello Hackers! 

After a short break, we are back with one new LEXYK mission and a LOT of fixes for the 15 previous maps. The new map is already playable in the 3 difficulty levels and it will be always the case for each new levels starting from now. 
Also, we are currently working on offering a lot of cool new gameplay features very soon so be prepared!

[h1]2017-08-11 Changelist v0.9.12 - Early Access [/h1]

[list]
[b] New Features[/b] 
[*] [b]New level[/b]  : LEXYK corporation seed in 3 difficulty levels (number #10F89F)

[b] Bug fixes[/b] 
[*]  66 corrections and bug fixes on previous 15 maps. 
[*]  Interactions with Trojan servers fixed: cooldown added.
[*]  Some coffee machines didn't make sounds when hacked.
[*]  Level design fixes : suppression of unreachable nodes.
[*]  English and French localization corrections
[/list]

We hope you'll enjoy the new map. And again we are always really happy to have a chat with you and get your ideas or suggestions so join us on the [url=http://hacktag-thegame.com/discord] Discord server.[/url] !

See you there![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/39d454697000547fa568b67bdb9ea01597eb9842.png[/img]

notes.notes:
Hello Hackers!

I hope you had a great week-end! Now it's Monday and it's time to work again on stealing data with a new Genethics map directly playable with three difficulty levels!

 Last week we offered the possibility to play the hard maps on others difficulties so today it is the turn of the easy maps to get new difficulty levels. [list]
[*] [b] 1 new Genethics map (seed #0093F6C7).[/b] 
[*] [b] New variations of difficulty for 3 maps.[/b] 
[/list]

This is the fashion week in Hacktag's world!
This weekly patch is all about stealing corporation with style and class. That's right, you can now start collecting new accessories to customize your character with hats, glasses or headsets.

notes.title: Hacktag Steam Early Access is live with a 25% discount off!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/16a236bfc367f68845f32fbe918442cb4a05efa0.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]That’s it! Hacktag starts its Early Access on Steam after 17 months of development![/b][/h1]

When we created Piece of Cake studios and decided to dedicated ourselves to make co-op games it was obvious that we wouldn’t finish Hacktag on our own, but with your help, as a team.
It is now time, after seventeen months of work, to include you in the development process with the beginning of the Steam Early Access.

[h1][b]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/b][/h1]
As of now, Hacktag is in a pretty advanced beta state. 

[h1]Online and local multiplayer[/h1]
You can already play online with a friend or locally with a good old-fashioned splitscreen mode. Hacktag already contains hours of co-op gameplay and many opportunities to yell at your partner. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/6b1fcd500cebdc0ffb4114295087e39f519e4e1b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Iterative procedural generation[/h1]
Every level in Hacktag is procedurally generated. During the very first week of the early-access, there will be 9 levels of one mission type in 3 corporations environments. In order to tweak the generation, we will first release an update of the game with new levels on a weekly basis which will allow you to enjoy quality improvement and new gameplay situations. Then depending on your feedback, we will update the game to give you a full access to the infinity of levels granted by our procedural generation with 9 story campaigns.


[h1]Experience system and character customization[/h1]
The experience system and all the passive and active skills you can unlock are already available although it might be tweaked and new skills may appear. Customization elements for your character is already available, but we will add many more unlockable options later on.


Our vision for the final version of the game is centered around these objectives in terms of content:
 [list]
[*]Fully accessible procedural generation of the levels. - you have access to 9 levels for the first week of EA.
[*]3 types of missions into 3 environments)
[*]More hacking and co-op mini-games.
[*]New game modes (time-attack etc...)
[*]Weekly challenges.
[*]9 stories for the corporations with unique NPCs for each player.
[*]Unlockabke Customization elements for the hacker & agent.
[*]Various types of guards and antiviruses.
[*]New environments variety and special rooms.
[*]Collectibles and a cool achievements list.
[*]+ the cool things you will suggest !
[/list]

Finally if you want to know more about our roadmap you can read this blog post [url=http://www.pieceofcake-studios.com/hacktag-steam-early-access-starts-tomorrow-our-roadmap/]public trello page[/url] 

See you soon!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/39d454697000547fa568b67bdb9ea01597eb9842.png[/img]

notes.title: NEW BETA SESSION IS NOW LIVE + NEW CONTEST
notes.notes:
Hi folks, 

We just openned the access to the beta for one last week-end before Hacktag makes the big jump into its Early access campaign!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581748/bb9a795039c2533218af143ce912e294d44c44dc.jpg[/img]

If you haven't subscribed to the beta yet don't worry! You still have time!
Just fill the form on our [url=http://www.hacktag-thegame.com/participate-in-hacktag-beta/]website here[/url].

 [h1]The beta contents : [/h1]

This beta contains the tutorial and 3 maps for the Data scavenging mission type. There is 2 maps in normal difficulty (targets : LEXYK and C.L.A.W Media ) and an easy one in the Genethics Corporation.

 To beginners, we strongly recommend to start with the easy level right after completing the tutorial, do not trust the cute kitty and hind on the key art, Hacktag is a hard game. 

 [h1]New week contest [/h1]

Be the 1st team in the CLAW or LEXYK map at the end of the beta to win your copy of the game! 
The beta ends monday at midnight (CET) Results will be announced on tuesday! Good luck!


[h1]Known blocking issues: [/h1]

Here are some annoying issues we are aware of. We will quickly fix those on saturday after a little sleep :

 [*] You may experience disconnections while playing online.
 [*] Switching roles in the lobby can cause some bugs.
 [*] LEXYK Map : some scanners can't be shut off. Some cooldown are missing on cameras. Guards behaviour can be weird when you make noises with coffee machine and phones. (but they are dumb rhinos so it's ok right? :-p )
 [*] CLAW : blocking bugs : if you get caught by some antiviruses of the map they won't necesseraly escort you to jail and the hacker will be stuck. 
[/list]

notes.title: We're giving away 5,000 keys for the Hacktag closed beta
notes.notes:
Update: We're all out! Thanks to everyone who got a key and have fun.

Original story: We're giving away 5,000 keys for the closed beta of Hacktag, a co-op stealth game hitting Steam Early Access on May 18. The closed beta will be running from today through May 15, so grab a key and give it a spin!

I got a chance to play Hacktag back at the PC Gamer Weekender and really enjoyed it. You try to pull off Mission Impossible-style heists with one player remotely hacking computers to unlock doors or disable cameras, while the other is actually physically in the space avoiding guards and sneaking around. It's got a cool level of asymmetry to it, each player relying on the other to progress while also competing to see who can get a higher score. 

The giveaway will be first come, first served, [update: and we've run out of keys now!] To be clear, this key is only for the closed beta and will not give you the full game when it launches on the 18th—however developer Piece of Cake Studios is running a competition during the course of the beta that could, as the top five teams of two on the leaderboards will each get a key to the full game when the beta ends.

notes.title: Hacktag is two-player stealth-o-hacking co-op
notes.notes: A game idea which sounds good: a two-player stealth game where one plays an agent sneaking into buildings and the other is a hacker futzing with the building’s systems, each supporting the other. Clandestine had a crack at that in an Alpha Protocol-y way and now Hacktag [official site] is having a go. It’ll hit early access in May but hey, you can watch this trailer now even if you’d rather wait for the finished game. Look: … [visit site to read more]
